command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-18a. Read, in full, the four scripts MIG-17 found that assume Ollama is a
# container. Two of them are wired to a scheduled task and now report a permanent false failure
# because of THIS lane's change:
#
#   lab-health.ps1              `docker ps --filter name=ollama` -> "Ollama : DOWN [FAIL]" forever
#   hermes-placement-readiness  $ollamaUp = ($running -contains "ollama") -> llmCap FAIL_CLOSED
#   core-online.ps1             `docker compose up -d postgres redis ollama` -> no such service
#   model-pull.ps1              `docker exec ollama ollama pull` -> no such container
#
# The packet's instruction for start-hermes.ps1 was to reconcile the DOCUMENTED start path with the
# new topology so the migration survives the documented way of running HERMES, not just the current
# way. These are the same class of file and the same instruction applies to them. Dump them whole so
# the edits can be surgical and reviewable rather than guessed from grep context.

foreach ($f in @('lab-health.ps1', 'hermes-placement-readiness.ps1', 'core-online.ps1', 'model-pull.ps1')) {
    $p = "C:\HermesLab\hermes\$f"
    Write-Output "======== $f  sha256=$((Get-FileHash $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()) bytes=$((Get-Item $p).Length)"
    Get-Content $p -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_ }
    Write-Output "======== end $f"
}
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
